# COMMONKIT

> Share and manage community machines: book access, govern shared budgets and earn usage rights by contributing. A NEAR HACKATHON 2026 project (Social Money and NFTs That Do Something), live on NEAR testnet.

Every shared machine gets its own keyless NEAR account running the same `asset` contract. Members reserve it and pay a fee plus a refundable deposit; a bridge next to the machine unlocks it only for a valid on-chain reservation. The asset keeps a capped float and sweeps the rest to the community's Sputnik DAO. When the machine's own telemetry crosses a profile rule, its operations agent may open an upkeep task; the member who does the work and is approved by a different member receives non-transferable NEP-171 usage rights.

Scope: NEAR testnet with device emulators and a simulator; device readings are labelled SIMULATED. Testnet NEAR has no value. Machine accounts hold money; NFT cards carry earned access and credentials.
